hero.title: Take Control of
hero.description: Jeseb Hub is a professional personal finance management suite. Track accounts, manage transactions, and visualize your financial health with powerful analytics — all in one place.

features.label: Features
features.title:
Everything you need to manage
your personal finances
features.subtitle: A comprehensive suite of tools designed to give you full control over your financial life.

accounts.title: Account Management
accounts.desc: Create and manage multiple accounts in one place. Track balances, monitor activity, and keep your finances organized effortlessly.

transactions.title: Transaction Tracking
transactions.desc: Log income and expenses with ease. Filter, search, and categorize every transaction for complete financial visibility.

analytics.title: Visual Analytics
analytics.desc: Beautiful charts and KPIs show your income breakdown, expense patterns, and balance evolution at a glance.

open.title: Self-Hosted & Private
open.desc: Deploy on your own infrastructure with Docker. Your data stays on your server, fully under your control.

privacy.title: Privacy First
privacy.desc: Your financial data never leaves your server. End-to-end encrypted, with optional 2FA for extra security.

import.title: CSV Import / Export
import.desc: Import your existing transactions from CSV files or export your data anytime. You always own your information.

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.title: Get started in minutes
howItWorks.subtitle: No complicated setup. Just simple, powerful financial tracking.

step1.title: Create your account
step1.desc: Sign up with your email and password. Secure 2FA is available for extra protection.

step2.title: Set up your accounts
step2.desc: Add your bank accounts, cash wallets, or any financial accounts you want to track.

step3.title: Track your transactions
step3.desc: Log income and expenses, categorize them, and watch your financial insights grow in real time.

cta.title: Ready to transform your finances?
cta.desc: Join Jeseb Hub today and take full control of your financial life. Built for people who value their privacy and financial independence.
